trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy and the long pole of the platinum: reach 100% on the in-game checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), which only opens after the story. The good news is the checklist is lenient — PowerPyx puts it near 60% true completion — and nothing on it is missable. Most of it is partial credit: 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, 15 of 18 meditations. Only a few lines need everything: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.

steps.t: Finish the story first; the checklist unlocks under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Progress made during the story already counts.
Complete any 100 optional missions (there are 200–300+; purple icons and black icons with pink letters). Each Moses/Randy vehicle delivery counts too.
Scan any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1) — boats and aircraft included. Start early and it finishes naturally.
Study any 100 of 255 animals through the binoculars (L1 to select, Up to zoom, hold R1 to study). Every breed of dog and cat counts separately; no hunting needed.
Complete any 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, and 15 of 18 meditations — pick the easiest in each set.
Clear the must-complete lines in full: all robberies, all underwater discoveries, all shooting ranges, all drone races, and Bret's 15 Target Decks.

The 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way — leave it for late, pick the easiest remaining ones, and track them under Progress > Challenges (the checkmark in the bottom-right of each challenge shows completion).

Track under Progress > Challenges; then push on to 70 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, and escape the heat zone. Earliest is after Coffee Break (Chapter 2), when you can free-roam together — call your partner with Right + Triangle. PowerPyx's easiest escape: drive through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia (Kelly County), where cops struggle to follow and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops when you drive out of the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' and its bank-vault robberies, which always bring 4 stars.

steps.t: After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle).
Cause carnage until you reach 4 stars, then escape — a fast sports motorcycle cuts through traffic; shoot at a chasing helicopter to shake it.
Easiest route: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County.
The trophy pops when you leave the red heat zone — keep driving until it clears.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

Keep the red/blue flashing wanted level (not the red heat level) — loot a couple of items per shop and crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs. PowerPyx's spot: the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, Chapter 3). The pop is delayed ~30 seconds after leaving the 3rd shop; if it does not pop, hit a 4th. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs (Ammu-Nation) and Zombix/Adrenaline for healing.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.countLabel: enemies downed in one Combat Focus
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming — time slows and weak spots highlight). It only lasts a few seconds, so buff first: eat/drink or wash up at home, take Adrenaline to extend it (hold L1, press Triangle), wear body armor, and use a full-auto assault rifle like the Duke 556. Line up 5 criminals at a Gang Operation and do not miss. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. It gets easier as Focus levels up (4 levels — shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots raise it); PowerPyx expects most players to reach Focus Level 4 naturally and earn this along the way.

steps.t: Raise Focus first: shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots — check it under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus.

Find 5 criminals together at a Gang Operation; trigger Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming) and down all 5 with an assault rifle.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it must be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not a plane on the airfield. Easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to board, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip, take off and fly 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport. The pop is slightly delayed.

Drive through an airfield fence, take the stairs by the boarding bridge into the plane, then upstairs to the cockpit.
Reverse the plane to the airstrip, take off, and fly at least 1 km away from the airport.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store clean, without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun (silent lockpick for alarmed doors) and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons. Enter through the backdoor with the Snap Gun (kicking the door trips the alarm), find the safe-code note in the backroom, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy pops shortly after you leave. PowerPyx's suggested spot: Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

Enter a jewelry store through its backdoor with the Snap Gun — never kick the door.
In the backroom, read the safe-code note, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm.
Leave undetected; the trophy pops shortly after you exit.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape, from the 8 large bank jobs in the game. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' (Wait at the Cafe) — it teaches the method and counts as your first vault: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to hand off a cash bag (hold Right). Afterward, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip (after his earlier quests, including 2 Payday Loans robberies) to mark vans with purple icons. Every vault robbery brings an instant 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to go unrecognised. The 100% checklist needs all 8, and each pays up to $205,000.

Tail security vans to banks (buy Yasmani's $10,000 tips after his quests) and rob the vault while it is open — bring your partner to carry a bag.
Escape the instant 4-star wanted level on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles.
Rob any 5 for the trophy; all 8 are needed for 100%.

The trophy pops after you escape the police — killing enemies is not needed. Not missable: if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns after a long time and you can go back for the rest.

Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). You can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on profile notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) — a demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action counts. Profiles run Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes, destroying evidence), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (mass killing, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable — a permanent status to avoid, since cops shoot on sight. PowerPyx expects this to land passively while working on the other trophies and 100%; every robbery and enemy encounter counts. Check the count by clicking the trophy in the PSN list.

Play normally — robberies and enemy encounters count toward the 500.
Avoid the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent and makes cops shoot on sight.
If it is still short at the end, farm it — but expect it to pop passively first.

It only pops on foot, not in a vehicle, and the pop is delayed until you are clear of the police search area.

By the blinking car, follow the path into the woods to the UFO (bright blue light in the sky); approach it and it drops an abducted woman. Talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside to pop the trophy. The spawn is slightly random. KeenGamer still lists this method as unconfirmed (see dispute D3).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). You need enough garages first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; in his garage choose 'Respray' then 'Register'. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses to unlock the Scooter Bros app and Moses as a contact.
Buy garages first (Little Boxes) — each adds parking spots to register vehicles into.
Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; choose Respray, then Register.
Use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep registration costs down.
